meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用你的个人微信号收发消息:扫码授权后,微信私信和群消息会被接进对话,由 Claude 回复。
howto.when: 当你在 .env 中设置 WECHAT_ENABLED=true、重启服务并扫码授权后,有人给该微信号发私信或群消息时就会触发。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw,按步骤安装并扫码。
say.note: 会逐步执行安装、校验和接线。

say.text: 把微信消息接到智能体,陌生人发消息时先让我审批。
say.note: 对应 request_approval 策略的接线流程。

say.text: 微信登录过期了,帮我清掉 auth.json 后重新扫码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages through your personal WeChat account: scan the QR code and approve, and WeChat DMs/group messages get pulled into the conversation and answered by Claude.
howto.when_en: Triggers when WECHAT_ENABLED=true is set in .env, the service restarts, and the QR scan is approved; then any WeChat DM or group message to that account triggers the integration.

say_en.text: Help me connect personal WeChat to NanoClaw, install and scan the QR.
say_en.note: Walks through install, validation and wiring.

say_en.text: Wire WeChat messages to the agent and ask me to approve strangers.
WeChat session expired, clear auth.json and re-scan.
